summary.text: Adam Martin is the Republican candidate for the Oklahoma House of Representatives, District 72, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Michelle McCane (D).

paragraphs.text: Adam Martin was born in Tulsa, Oklahoma, and earned a bachelor's degree from Oklahoma State University in 2020.
He has worked as a legal assistant and has served as Tulsa District Chair of the African American Federation.
Martin was a candidate for Oklahoma's 1st Congressional District in 2022, when incumbent Kevin Hern (R) won the general election.
In 2024 he lost the Democratic primary for Oklahoma House District 72 to Michelle McCane, 72.5% to 27.5%.
